description: This file implements the IpcChannelImpl class and related IPC mechanisms for the Rialto project, including socket management, message processing, and event handling.

classes.name: ChannelImpl
classes.description: Implements the IChannel interface, managing IPC communication via UNIX domain sockets, epoll, timers, and eventfd, handling message sending, receiving, and timeout management.

methods.name: createConnectedSocket
methods.description: Creates and connects a UNIX domain socket to the specified socket path.

methods.name: attachSocket
methods.description: Attaches an existing socket file descriptor, verifying its type and setting it to non-blocking mode.

methods.name: initChannel
methods.description: Initializes epoll, timerfd, and eventfd for IPC event handling.

methods.name: termChannel
methods.description: Cleans up and closes all IPC-related file descriptors and clears pending method calls.

methods.name: disconnect
methods.description: Gracefully disconnects the socket and signals the event loop to wake up.

methods.name: disconnectNoLock
methods.description: Removes socket from epoll, shuts down, and closes the socket without acquiring the lock.

methods.name: isConnected
methods.description: Checks if the channel is currently connected.

methods.name: isConnectedInternal
methods.description: Internal check for socket connection status, protected by mutex.

methods.name: fd
methods.description: Returns the epoll file descriptor.

methods.name: wait
methods.description: Waits for events with a specified timeout.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Processes incoming messages, timeouts, and wake events.

methods.name: unsubscribe
methods.description: Removes an event handler by its event tag.

methods.name: processSocketEvent
methods.description: Reads and processes messages from the socket, including file descriptors.

methods.name: processTimeoutEvent
methods.description: Handles timeout events, cancelling method calls that have timed out.

methods.name: processWakeEvent
methods.description: Clears wake signals from eventfd.

methods.name: updateTimeoutTimer
methods.description: Updates the timerfd to trigger at the next method call timeout.

methods.name: processServerMessage
methods.description: Parses and handles messages from the server, including replies, errors, and events.

methods.name: processReplyFromServer
methods.description: Handles reply messages from the server, matching them to requests.

methods.name: processErrorFromServer
methods.description: Handles error messages from the server.

methods.name: processEventFromServer
methods.description: Handles event messages from the server, invoking registered handlers.

methods.name: readMessageFds
methods.description: Extracts file descriptors from received message control data.

methods.name: addReplyFileDescriptors
methods.description: Injects received file descriptors into protobuf reply messages.

methods.name: complete
methods.description: Completes a method call successfully, invoking its closure.

methods.name: completeWithError
methods.description: Completes a method call with an error, setting failure reason.

methods.name: getMessageFds
methods.description: Extracts file descriptors from a protobuf message.

methods.name: CallMethod
methods.description: Serializes and sends a method call over IPC, handling file descriptors and response expectations.

methods.name: subscribeImpl
methods.description: Registers an event handler for a specific event name.
